title: C¹ push-forward integrals converge to the tangential push-forward (part (I) of the consistency step)
statement: Let P, Q, k ∈ ℕ, H^k := μHE[k] on ℝ^P, and let (M, θ, ξ) satisfy IsRectifiableTriple univ k M θ ξ. Let g : ℝ^P → ℝ^Q be Λ-Lipschitz and L : ℝ^P → L(ℝ^P, ℝ^Q) such that for H^k-a.e. x ∈ M, for every linear subspace T_x that is a weighted approximate tangent space of (M, θ) at x (HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt k M θ x T_x) and every v ∈ T_x, the map t ↦ g(x + t v) has derivative L(x)v at t = 0. Assume θ is H^k-integrable on M ∩ g⁻¹(K) for every compact K ⊆ ℝ^Q. Let g_j : ℝ^P → ℝ^Q (j ∈ ℕ) be C¹ maps, Λ′-Lipschitz for one common Λ′, converging uniformly to g on ℝ^P, and let ω : ℝ^Q → Covector (Eucl Q) k be continuous with compact support. Then ∫_M θ(x)·(Dg_j(x)_#ξ(x))(ω(g_j(x))) dH^k(x) → ∫_M θ(x)·(L(x)_#ξ(x))(ω(g(x))) dH^k(x) as j → ∞, where A_# = nVectorPushforward k A and Dg_j(x) = fderiv ℝ (g_j) x.
lean_statement: ∀ (P Q k : ℕ) (M : Set (Eucl P)) (θ : Eucl P → ℝ) (ξ : Eucl P → NVector (Eucl P) k) (g : Eucl P → Eucl Q) (Λ : ℝ≥0) (L : Eucl P → (Eucl P →L[ℝ] Eucl Q)), IsRectifiableTriple (univ : Set (Eucl P)) k M θ ξ → LipschitzWith Λ g → (∀ᵐ x ∂((μHE[k] : Measure (Eucl P)).restrict M), ∀ Tx : Submodule ℝ (Eucl P), HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt k M θ x Tx → ∀ v ∈ Tx, HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => g (x + t • v)) (L x v) 0) → (∀ K : Set (Eucl Q), IsCompact K → IntegrableOn θ (M ∩ g ⁻¹' K) (μHE[k] : Measure (Eucl P))) → ∀ (gj : ℕ → Eucl P → Eucl Q) (Λ' : ℝ≥0), (∀ j, ContDiff ℝ 1 (gj j)) → (∀ j, LipschitzWith Λ' (gj j)) → TendstoUniformly gj g atTop → ∀ ω : Eucl Q → Covector (Eucl Q) k, Continuous ω → HasCompactSupport ω → Tendsto (fun j => ∫ x in M, θ x * nVectorPushforward k (fderiv ℝ (gj j) x) (ξ x) (ω (gj j x)) ∂(μHE[k] : Measure (Eucl P))) atTop (𝓝 (∫ x in M, θ x * nVectorPushforward k (L x) (ξ x) (ω (g x)) ∂(μHE[k] : Measure (Eucl P))))
